messages:
olivia: hi team, newbie question  opened my first PR from a fork and GH shows a failed required check 'github/actions' but the Actions run says 'skipped' with a 403 when trying to set status. PR: https://github.com/redwood/example/pull/210
mike: welcome @olivia! for forks GH actions runs are restricted; 403 when setting status usually means the app/webhook can't write to the target repo. did you keep the repo's default branch protection?
olivia: branch protection is standard (require ci checks). the actions job log shows: 
```
Run actions/checkout@v3
Warning: unable to request repository permissions
Error: Request failed with status code 403
```
hana: are you using a workflow that posts a check run using the repo token? Forks only get a read-only token; any steps that try to write back (like status updates) will 403.
olivia: hmm the workflow has a step that calls a small GH app to update PR metadata and post a status.
infra-oncall: @olivia that's the issue. GH apps or workflows that mutate PRs need write perms and will fail from forks. Common fixes: 1) run the write-step only on push events to branches in the main repo (not on pull_request from fork); 2) use the repo maintainer to re-run the job on a branch copy; or 3) create a branch in the main repo and push your change there.
mike: for onboarding we usually ask new hires to branch in the main repo (helps avoid token limitations). if you want i can mirror your fork branch into main and push.
olivia: thanks 60a i can recreate as a branch on the main repo, but curious if there's a quick workaround for this PR so i don't lose CI history.
gha-bot: check-suite for commit abc123: completed (some checks skipped due to workflow permissions)
infra-oncall: quick workaround: temporarily remove the 'require status checks' branch protection for the branch, merge, then re-enable. Not ideal. Better: mirror into a branch on the main repo (we can do that automatically). @mike can run the mirror script if you want.
mike: i can run mirrorer/run-mirror --from-fork olivia/example --to-branch users/olivia/first-pr and trigger the build. doing that now.
buildkite-bot: buildkite pipeline "redwood-ci/main" queued for PR #210 (job id: bk-21001).
olivia: awesome, thank you!
buildkite-bot: pipeline bk-21001 started.
buildkite-bot: pipeline bk-21001 finished  all steps passed ✅
gha-bot: status for commit def456: all required checks passed
mike: mirrored branch pushed and checks passing. @olivia try merging from users/olivia/first-pr or i'll open a PR from it for you.
olivia: i opened the branch PR and merge button is now enabled 389 first PR merged, thanks team!
hana: welcome aboard @olivia :tada: we'll add a short onboarding note about fork limitations and the mirroring helper to the handbook.
infra-oncall: follow-up: adding a small item to the new-hire checklist so folks branch in-repo if they expect workflows that write back to PRs or use maintainer-only apps.
